name: Vaultwarden
summary: Self-hosted password manager server compatible with Bitwarden clients, with open sign-up disabled and an admin panel.
notes: Vaultwarden 1.37.4 pinned by tag and digest. Sign-up is disabled; the owner opens /admin with the admin token and invites users (an invited email address can then register). The admin token is stored only as an Argon2id hash (argon2 package, piped on stdin, no TTY needed). Caddy provides HTTPS, required by the web vault: Let's Encrypt with a domain, a self-signed certificate on the bare IP.

licence.note: Vaultwarden AGPL-3.0; its bundled web vault (bw_web_builds / Bitwarden web client) is GPL-3.0. Caddy Apache-2.0. Docker Engine Apache-2.0. Source of the unmodified server is available from the upstream repository.
